name: Garden planner
description: Plans a garden from a plant CSV (name, sow_from, sow_to, harvest_days, spacing_cm; optional hemisphere, water_days). The hemisphere is always an argument (hemisphere=north or hemisphere=south): none is assumed. Calendar shows what can be sown from a start date and when it can be harvested; Bed counts how many plants fit a bed; Log check finds impossible or out-of-season entries in a garden log; To-do lists sowings, harvests and watering day by day. Dates come from your CSV, not a forecast. The original is never changed.

presets.label: Sowing and harvest calendar
presets.description: Give start=YYYY-MM-DD and hemisphere=north or hemisphere=south in the extra arguments. For every plant: sowing window (open now, opens in N days, next year), earliest and latest harvest date, spacing. Months may be numbers or names in six languages; a row marked for the other hemisphere is moved by six months and flagged.

presets.label: Plants per bed
presets.description: Give bed=240x120 (and unit=cm, m, in or ft; plant=NAME for one plant) in the extra arguments. Counts how many fit with each plant's spacing_cm: on a square grid and in staggered rows.

presets.label: Check a garden log
presets.description: The input is a log CSV (date, bed, plant, action). Finds unreadable and future dates, duplicates, harvests with no sowing or far sooner than the plant allows, and sowings outside the window. Extra arguments: plants=FILE.csv hemisphere=north.

presets.label: To-do list for the next days
presets.description: Give start=YYYY-MM-DD hemisphere=north or south, days=14, and optionally log=LOG.csv water=3. A day-by-day checklist: sowing windows opening or closing, harvests due for what the log says is in the ground, and watering at the interval you set.
